newsitem.title: USA: Johnson Controls denies merger firm's claim.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Controls denies merger firm's claim.

text.p: Johnson Controls Inc on Wednesday denied allegations made in a suit that the company failed to pay standard fees to a merger specialist firm for assisting it in acquiring Prince Automotive in October.
A spokeswoman told Reuters the company will vigorously defend itself against the suit filed in Milwaukee County Circuit Court by Corporate Development Associates Inc of Hilton Head, S.C.
She said Johnson Controls dealt directly with Holland, Mich.-based Prince Automotive rather than any intermediary.

The Milwaukee Journal Sentinel, quoting Corporate Development president James Anderson, said his company's standard fee would have amounted to $7.25 million if Anderson had seen the deal all the way through.
Johnson Controls manufactures building control systems and automotive products.
